thread:
maria: Quick heads up — scheduling a short engine patch tonight 22:00 UTC. This is a tiny kernel ABI fix + a conservative quant profile tweak for long sequences. Planning ~15m window, non-disruptive but want to be ready to revert fast.
cheng: I can take pre-checks and run the smoke script. Will be online at 21:45 UTC.
anya: I can monitor latency dashboards and do a quick eval on the long-seq workload after deploy. Which dashboards should I watch?
maria: Thanks. Watch rt/engine/latency (p50/p95), rt/engine/tokens-per-sec, and errors/kv-miss. Also keep an eye on the routing fallback rate (route/fallback-rate).
jamal: I'll own rollback if anything looks off. Quick question: is this touching KV cache layout or only kernels + quant params?
maria: No KV layout changes — only kernel binary and quant profile JSON tweak. Should be safe for cache compatibility, but validate KV hits after warmup.
leo: I'll queue the rollout and annotate the deploy with the rollback tag: engine@v2b -> rollback to engine@v2a. Deploy-bot will post the link.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by leo at 22:00 UTC. CI: green. Steps: 1) drain 10% of traffic from each zone, 2) apply kernel package to subset, 3) apply quant profile, 4) run smoke script, 5) shift traffic back.
maria: Smoke checklist (short):
```
- run ./infra/smoke.sh --suite=runtime_quick --nodes=3
- curl -sS https://redwood/health/runtime | jq .ok
- run small eval: python tools/eval_longseq.py --model=opt-1.3b --iters=5
- check redis kv-miss rate in last 2m
```
cheng: I'll run the smoke script and paste outputs here. I'll also run the eval against a canary slot before broadening.
anya: If p95 latency jumps >10ms or kv-miss increases >3% we should pause. I'll signal :eyes: in thread.
maria: Agreed. Jamal, rollback steps are standard but call them out here for clarity.
jamal: Rollback steps:
1) mark deploy failed in console, set traffic weight back to previous model variant,
2) revert kernel package on nodes,
3) re-apply previous quant profile,
4) run quick sanity: ./infra/smoke.sh --sanity-only
I can start within 2m of a pause signal.
leo: Ops note: doing a staggered upgrade by AZ to keep global latency stable. Each AZ will be ~3-4m. Total window still ~15m.
maria: Post-deploy verification: check traces on tracing/redwood/runtime for soft errors, and run a small sample of customer prompt traces (sanitized) for quality regressions. If anything weird, tag telemetry with "engine-tweak-2418765432".
deploy-bot: At 22:00 UTC: starting drain on az-1. CI logs: https://ci.company/exec/2418765432
cheng: smoke.sh output (snippet):
```
OK runtime_quick suite: 0 failures
p50 latency: 12.3ms
p95 latency: 28.9ms
kv-miss: 0.6%
```
anya: Watching dashboard: p95 stable, no spike. KV-miss at 0.7% now. :thumbsup:
maria: Great. Proceed to roll next AZ. Keep posting short status lines so we have an audit trail.
leo: AZ-2 applied kernel + quant, running smoke now.
cheng: AZ-2 smoke: OK, p95 +3ms, kv-miss +0.2%. All good.
anya: Quality eval: no obvious regression on long-seq samples.
maria: Rolling final AZ. If all green, we'll close the window and mark success.
deploy-bot: Final AZ done. Traffic restored to 100%. Deploy status: SUCCESS. Logs: https://ci.company/exec/2418765432/final
maria: Thanks everyone. Post-deploy items: leave monitoring watch for 2 hours and I'll open a tiny follow-up doc with perf deltas. If you see anything odd ping me directly. :heart:
leo: Noted. Closing thread in ~30m unless anyone flags.
cheng: LGTM.
anya: LGTM.
jamal: LGTM — rollback ready.
